anomalies.observed: The netlist contains two ATtiny microcontrollers, U2 (ATtiny45-20P) and U3 (ATtiny13V-10S), wired in parallel on every functional net: +5V, GND, POT, PWM, RST, SCK, SDA, and TACH.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes the board as 'an ATtiny-driven fan controller' (singular), implying one ATtiny should drive the fan-control and interface signals. If two footprints were intended as package options, the netlist would normally mark one as unpopulated/DNP or otherwise indicate only one MCU is intended to be present in the build.
anomalies.impact: If both MCUs are populated, their output pins (PB0, PB1, PB2) are tied together. This can cause bus contention, unpredictable fan control, and problems programming through the shared ISP header because two devices share MISO/MOSI/SCK.
